$comment: The vanilla crafting table is the block itself. Its top texture has a 3 x 3 grid with cells centred on 5, 8 and 11 pixels: grid_N lie in those cells, as big as the cell inside the lines, the vanilla screen's order from the far left (as the camera sees it) to the near right. The result hovers over the right edge like a dropped item, its count standing at its foot facing the camera (lying, it was squashed off the edge); choice_N right of it, in two rows clear of its tall pick box, are the other things the grid makes when Polymorph lets the player choose (RecipeChoice), hidden otherwise. grid is a pivot in the middle for sounds. book_open is the recipe book, open in the air left of the table; put away it lies shut on the middle of the table's left edge, within 3 x 3 of its pixels and turned 12 degrees, as if put down by hand (extra.rest: offset from where it hangs, the turn that lays it flat and skews it, scale). The camera stands above the near edge, looking down at about 55 degrees; clicks count from 60% of the flight. The hotbar stays where the HUD has it and takes clicks; over it rows of the other stacks a crafting grid can use, in the order they had when the table opened, with one empty slot always.
